## Finding

`sdas8051` built from r17158 assembles the test case of the ticket and reports no error. In the
listing the second `.ORG`, the label `L1`, and the `LJMP` are at 008000. The reporter's listing
from SDCC 4.3.0 has FF808000 in these three lines.

Three shorter files were assembled as well. One has only the `JZ` line between the two `.ORG`
lines, one has only the `ACALL` line, and one has a `NOP`. In each listing the second `.ORG` is at
008000.

SDCC 4.3.0 was not built for a comparison, and the revision after which the result differs was not
identified. The test ran on a Linux host. The ticket does not name the reporter's host.

The link step was not run, so it is not known whether the three branches to the numeric address
0x0000 are resolved correctly.
